summary: Missoula County, MT tower: firelookout.com dates it 1932 and says it was destroyed in 1966 on private land; a 1933 newspaper item names a different forest.

facts.status_note: Firelookout.com says destroyed in 1966; the Forest Lookouts page lists it as removed

access.note: Firelookout.com says the site is located on private property

events.note: Firelookout.com dates the 40-foot pole L-4 tower to 1932; a 1933 newspaper item conflicts (see resolved_conflicts)
September 1933 newspaper item reports the transport of a 40-foot lookout tower to Cayuse, naming the Clearwater forest
March 1934 Daily Missoulian item reports Civilian Conservation workers building a road from the Nine Mile region to the Cayuse Hill lookout on the Lolo forest

evidence.supports: page places the site in the Lolo National Forest
September 1933 item reports completing the transport of a 40-foot lookout tower to Cayuse, naming the Clearwater forest
evidence.quote: Robert Johnson of Missoula last week completing the transport of a 40-foot lookout tower to Cayuse, on the Clearwater forest.

evidence.supports: March 1934 item reports road construction to the Cayuse hill lookout on the Lolo forest by Civilian Conservation workers
evidence.quote: Construction of a road from the Nine Mile region to the Cayuse hill lookout on the Lolo forest

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page lists the tower as removed

evidence.quote: Site is located on private property.

evidence.supports: March 1934 road work was done by Civilian Conservation workers

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com gives 1932; a September 27, 1933 newspaper item reports that the tower had been transported to Cayuse the week before. The 1932 date is kept as firelookout's date and the 1933 item is flagged.
The Forest Lookouts page and a March 1934 item place the lookout on the Lolo forest; a September 1933 item says the Clearwater forest. Lolo is kept as the agency.
Firelookout.com gives destruction in 1966; the Forest Lookouts page lists the tower only as removed. Both say gone; the 1966 date comes from firelookout.com alone.

notes_for_editor: Brief record (gone, Lolo NF, 12.2 m) matches the sources, so no corrections. A 2016 Forest Service list of Clearwater lookouts (fs.usda.gov/media/259185) has no Cayuse entry in the text I searched, so the 1933 'Clearwater forest' wording looks like an error or may refer to a different tower; a Lolo NF or Montana SHPO record would settle it. The 1932 build date and the private-land note rest on firelookout.com alone. The web search turned up only an unrelated Cayuse Hills range in Sweet Grass County. No staffing or fire records found.
